openwrt_wiki.Warnung: Versions of ath79 firmware for the GL-AR300M prior to November 15, 2019 are not capable of reliably upgrading directly to the new GL-AR300M (NAND) images. Upgrade with U-Boot is recommended. U-Boot can be accessed without a serial connection. Direct upgrades may result in the device unexpectedly booting into the "old" NAND-resident system and its configuration. If this is a "stock" OEM system, its default LAN IP is 192.168.8.1.
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout (cat /proc/mtd): mtd0 00040000 u-boot; mtd1 00010000 u-boot-env; mtd2 00fa0000 firmware; mtd3 00280000 kernel; mtd4 00d20000 rootfs; mtd5 00960000 rootfs_data; mtd6 00010000 art
openwrt_wiki.OEM easy installation using u-boot: holding the reset button, powering the device and waiting for 5 flashes of the LED; http://192.168.1.1, PC static IP 192.168.1.2/255.255.255.0; old u-boot may not accept recent images, upgrade via http://192.168.1.1/uboot.html (fails on older version); AR300M16 models purchased as late as Nov 2024 had an old u-boot: device ended up in u-boot after each reboot, upgrading u-boot solved it; upload glinet_gl-ar300m-nand-initramfs-kernel.bin, then factory/sysupgrade
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: The case has no screws. Sticker needs not be removed. Gently pry the sides from the back-cover and pop back-cover open. It's held on with two retaining tabs on front/back, one on antenna sides.
openwrt_wiki.Hardware mods: The switch on the side of the router is not very robust. If it should break a PCM12SMTR can be used to replace the switch.
openwrt_wiki.OEM bootlog (Auszug): SoC: Qualcomm Atheros QCA9533 ver 2 rev 0; memory: 08000000 @ 00000000; Clocks: CPU:650.000MHz, DDR:597.534MHz; console=ttyS0,115200; mtdparts=spi0.0:256k(u-boot)ro,64k(u-boot-env),16000k(reserved),64k(art)ro;spi0.1:2048k(kernel),-(ubi); m25p80 spi0.0: w25q128 (16384 Kbytes); spi-nand: Giga SPI NAND was found, 128 MiB, block size 128 KiB, page size 2048; eth0: AG71xx mode:MII; ag71xx-mdio.1: Found an AR934X built-in switch; eth1: mode:GMII; ieee80211 phy0: Atheros AR9531 Rev:2
openwrt_wiki.Notes: Old u-boot version requires an update: fails to accept firmware image (http connection reset after upload) and fails to upgrade itself; flash u-boot on /dev/mtd0 from running system
openwrt_wiki.Revisionen: 2025-11-05 Flash Layout; 2025-08-22 'Remove 64ram tag, all versions have 128MB RAM'; 2024-11-29 Hinweis alter U-Boot; 2024-05-21 separate data entry for GL-AR300M16

openwrt_git_nand.Flash: 16 MB NOR flash, 128 MB SPI NAND flash
openwrt_git_nand.Boot: Devices with both NOR and NAND flash can support independent firmware on each, with U-Boot able to boot from either. The OEM U-Boot will fall back to the NOR firmware after three "unsuccessful" boots.

openwrt_git_nand.Upgrade ohne force: von OEM v3 NOR ar71xx (openwrt-ar300m16-*.bin), OpenWrt 18.06 ar71xx, OpenWrt 19.07 ar71xx; andere über U-Boot
openwrt_git_nand.U-Boot: The GL-AR300M OEM U-Boot allows upload and flashing of either NOR firmware (sysupgrade.bin) or NAND firmware (factory.img) through its HTTP-based GUI. Serial connectivity is not required.
openwrt_git_nand.Bootcounter: implemented by the OEM using u-boot-env; switch on the side cannot be used to select NOR vs. NAND boot; fail-over only from NAND to NOR; to save flash wear, it is only reset when running the glinet,gl-ar300m-nand firmware
